newsitem.title: USA: Edison Brothers March same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Edison Brothers March same-store sales fall.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said Thursday same-store sales for the five weeks ended April 5 were $85.8 million, down 3.5 percent from the comparable period last year.

Total sales for March were $91 million, a decrease of 14.4 percent versus the $106.3 million last year. Edison Brothers operated an average of 1,738 stores in March 1997, 16.8 percent fewer than the 2,089 stores open in March 1996, the company said.
The March sales period reflects one less shopping day this year than last year, Edison Brothers said.

For the nine-week period ending April 5, 1997, same store sales were $145.1 million, a decrease of 1.9 percent or $2.8 million versus last year. Total sales for the period fell 13.3 percent to $153.9 million versus $177.5 million last year.

Edison Brothers said its same-store apparel sales were off 4.9 percent for the month and footwear same-store sales were flat. Year to date, apparel same-store sales were down 2.6 percent and footwear was off 0.1 percent.
